# opencode

> opencode is a spec-driven project whose validated source of truth lives in doc/arch; specs come first and code follows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

Contract terms: exit code, `--json`, guard, validate. Config families: project,
git, guard, context, dedupe, adr, stats, semantic, gitlab, hygiene, compliance,
workflow, privacy.

## Speckit CLI surface

- `speckit init` · `speckit constitution` · `speckit specify` · `speckit clarify`
